final_text: The single spec in the queue, `dds_250msps`, is finalized. L1 `run_dse` spent the full 400-eval budget and produced a 29-design feasible, non-dominated Pareto front over luts vs accuracy_bits; the min-luts selection rule picked `pipelined:data_width=18,n_iter=15,angle_guard=1,frac_guard=0,rounding=round` (estimate luts=905, accuracy_bits=13, ffs=938, throughput=264 MSPS, max_abs_err=0.000119 = 2^-13.04). The spec has no system scenario, so L2 simulation was not required. L3 `verify_rtl` was exact (0/109112 mismatches across Verilator and Icarus, latency 17); L4 recorded synthesis measured 924 LUTs, 909 FFs, Fmax 165.3 MHz; L5 `back_annotate` flagged a winner change because the measured throughput falls 4.4% short of 250 MSPS under yosys+nextpnr-xilinx, so `reexplore` ran the L5 loop (60 evals, refit calibration) and confirmed the same selection (refit estimate luts=850, throughput=285). The loop was stable, and `finalize` recorded the selection.
